As you know, we're forming a staff listening council to address concerns about the recently combined groups. Before I sign off on the council's plan, I want to hear from each of you — one at a time, uninterrupted — regarding your recommendations for the council's design, including any prior agreements, availability constraints, or policy considerations that affect your recommendation. Please also identify any action items and who should own them. Let's begin — who would like to go first?

transcript.text: I need to formally reveal a prior agreement and a set of observations that affect my recommendation. First, I personally observed four tense exchanges in which employees stopped speaking when their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees asked me not to put them in a manager-led forum. Second, during a separate planning conversation, I confirmed that Leah, an HR operations partner from outside the department with no reporting relationship to council participants, has agreed to facilitate the council. I had not raised either point with Priya before now because the affected employees did not want the issue escalated through their managers. My recommendation is that Leah be named as the council's facilitator, given her outside status and existing agreement to serve, and that the relationship field reflect that she is an external HR operations partner with no reporting line to any council participant. The action owner for arranging the facilitation should be assigned as part of completing the approval form.

transcript.text: I need to formally reveal a policy constraint and an action-ownership assignment that affect my recommendation. First, I confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council. Second, I am the designated action owner for arranging the facilitator's logistics before approval. Neither the policy update nor this facilitation-logistics assignment has yet been attached to Priya's planning packet. My recommendation is that the council design incorporate the anonymous written question channel as a required element, that no direct supervisor serve as an observer, and that I be recorded as the action owner for arranging the facilitator's logistics on the approval form before it is signed.
